free_fit.title: Rotclimate Free-Fit Atlas
free_fit.eyebrow: Simulated climate · 25 seasonal steps · every setting fitted freely to your painted zones
free_fit.lede: Click anywhere on land to see its climate through the local year, and which real places feel most alike.
free_fit.note: World and physics fitted to your map together: reversed spin, 32.9°N, 15.8° tilt, true north 7.4° anticlockwise of the map's top edge. Winds now come from the same pressure physics as the Earth fit, and its planetary-scale setting landed on Earth's own value; the map adds a stronger local term (heat lows and sea breezes over ~320 km). Matches the painted zones better than the previous fit (score 0.529 against 0.520).

earth_physics.title: Rotclimate Earth-Physics Atlas
earth_physics.eyebrow: Simulated climate · 25 seasonal steps · physics that also reproduces real Earth climates
earth_physics.lede: Click anywhere on land to see its climate through the local year, and which real places feel most alike.
earth_physics.note: Physics fitted on six real regions (California, Iberia, south-east US, Levant, Central Asia, East China) and only allowed to drift slightly while matching your map; reversed spin. It gets the Mediterranean band right but cannot make the painted cold-dry north dry.

earth_fit.title: Rotclimate Earth-Fit Atlas
earth_fit.eyebrow: Simulated climate · 25 seasonal steps · physics that also reproduces real Earth climates
earth_fit.lede: Click anywhere on land to see its climate through the local year, and which real places feel most alike.
earth_fit.note: Physics fitted on six real regions (California, Iberia, south-east US, Levant, Central Asia, East China) and allowed to drift only slightly while matching your map (its Earth score stays within 3 % of the Earth reference); the world fitted to your map: reversed spin, 36.5°N, 30.7° tilt, true north 24.8° anticlockwise of the map's top edge. The climate is averaged over three random layouts of the unknown land beyond the map. It matches the painted zones far less well than the free fit (score 0.18 against 0.53, 26 % of cells exact against 59 %): with Earth's physics the map has no swamp, little hot or cold desert, and a Mediterranean band that is a quarter dry.
